gpu_failure_data.game_mechanic_recommendation: at cluster scale >=10,000 GPUs, trigger a 'failure wave' roughly every 3-4 hours of game-time-equivalent, each event taking out 0.5-1% of the active cluster, with GPU+HBM3 as ~50% of causes; reserve larger multi-day 'failure wave' crisis events (several % of fleet) as rare, high-drama Act II moments rather than the common case
